title: VTC — Vetting PCS Tokens — payload
description: A vetter draws its tick of attestation tokens. The draw is unconditional and on a schedule — a vetter asks whether or not it has vetted anyone — because a fetch that tracked activity would report activity.

label.description: The token label to draw under: the community's current monthly label, or an event label it has approved for this vetter.

tick.description: The vetter's own schedule counter for this label. It makes `once per tick` a rule the community can enforce without learning whether the vetter has been busy.

requests.description: One blinded serial per token asked for. More than the community's published `dripPerTick` is refused outright — the cap is the community's, not the asker's restraint.

commitment.description: A commitment to a serial only the vetter knows.

openingProof.description: Proof that the commitment opens to a serial the vetter holds, bound to this label, member and tick.

Response.title: VTC Vetting PCS Tokens — response payload
Response.description: One blind signature per request, in the order asked.
